notes: Scene prompts no longer get stuck on day one. Each world's scene prompt was sent with every reply forever, so days later the AI was still being told "today is your first day" (Angels of Delusion) or "the three of them are walking up the temple stairs right now" (Yunkui Summit), and characters kept acting like you'd just met. Now the scene prompt only counts as "right now" for the opening, meaning the first few replies on the first day. After that it turns into background: "how this story started, X days ago". The "where everyone is" and "what happens next" parts are dropped, and the AI is told people know you now based on what actually happened since. Works for every world, 1-on-1s and custom scenes, and for stories you've already started.
